verdict.rationale: Munito documents separate EU and US hosts that keep processing in their region, and lists the available regions for each model. It also offers routing to Munito Compute Cloud in Europe or to your own cloud. Combined with zero data retention, this lets a user choose where their data is handled. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of stored-data residency (as opposed to processing location), detail on how region selection works per request or account, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
